description.en: A complete early sauropodomorph reconstruction with a heavy low body, broad supporting stance, long neck and tapering tail. Mounted skeletons inform the form, but soft tissues, body width and living posture are inferred.
description.zh: 早期蜥脚形类完整复原，具有低而厚重的躯干、宽支撑肢态、长颈和渐细长尾。装架骨骼提供形态参考，软组织、体宽与活体姿态为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete early sauropodomorph retaining original low heavy-bodied trunk with broad supporting limb stance, long neck and complete tapering tail. Not a renamed gracile bipedal Massospondylus.

scientific_limits.en: Whole-animal artistic reconstruction, not one specimen scan. Actually viewed Ortiz et al.2025 Fig6.4 original museum skeleton mount and Fig9.3 newer replica mount; their restored portions and posture are not all original anatomy. Tail cropped in Fig6.4, complete replica silhouette informs missing span. Copenhagen skull is a cast with unverified accession, not an independently verified holotype skull. Length5.2m is NHM estimate, not measured from these photos. Body width, muscles, skin, colour and life pose inferred. Broad stance means stable supporting placement, not reptile-like sprawling limbs.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原，非单标本扫描。已实看Ortiz等2025图6.4真实旧骨架装架及图9.3新复制装架；补配部分和装架姿势不均等于原位解剖。图6.4尾端裁切，完整复制装架仅辅助尾轮廓。哥本哈根头骨为未核馆藏编号的铸模，不宣称独立核实了正模颅骨。5.2米来自NHM估值，非照片实测。躯体宽度、肌肉、皮肤颜色与活体姿态属推断。宽支撑肢态不等于爬行动物式横向匍匐。

scale.basis: Natural History Museum Dino Directory genus estimate; not10m, not specimen measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Deep heavy ribcage/abdomen and relatively low body carried between four robust supporting limbs.
Long neck with small elongate sloping skull, not boxy Camarasaurus head.
Broad stable support footprint without extreme sprawling shoulders/elbows.
Complete long gradually tapering tail with strong base, no spikes or tail club.
All four robust limbs readable, trunk not reduced to a thin bipedal cursor silhouette.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Ortiz et al.2025 Fig6.4 old original-bone mount, Fig9.3 new replica; Table2 names holotypePVL3808 but captions do not explicitly identify mount accession. Copenhagen skull cast photo identified at genus level.
